meta.title: Cruise Sindibad | Egyptian IQF Frozen Fruits & Vegetables Exporter
meta.description: Cruise Sindibad grows, freezes, and exports premium IQF fruits and vegetables from Egypt's fertile lands for importers, distributors, and food manufacturers worldwide.

hero.lead: Cruise Sindibad supplies premium frozen fruits and vegetables to importers, distributors, and food processors worldwide. Frozen within hours of harvest in Egypt, delivered directly to you with uncompromised quality.

markets.text: Reliably supplying customers in the EU, UK, Middle East, North America & Asia.

about.title: From the Nile Delta to Global Cold Chains.
about.lead: Connecting the fertility of Egyptian agriculture with strict international standards. Cruise Sindibad is a direct grower, processor, and exporter of frozen fruits and vegetables. Working closely with local farmers, we select the finest produce from the fertile Nile Delta. Flash freezing immediately after harvest preserves full nutritional value, natural taste, and year-round freshness.

iqf.title: Sustainable Farming & Sourcing
iqf.text: We promote responsible agriculture, shorten the supply chain, and actively minimize food waste from the fields to final packaging.

farms.title: Quality Control & Food Safety
farms.text: We guarantee strict packaging hygiene, full batch traceability, and rigorous compliance with global food safety standards.

export.title: Reliable International Export
export.text: We offer stable year-round supply, flexible packing options (gastro, industrial, private label), and safe shipping anywhere in the world.

points.residue: Strictly tested for pesticide residues (EU MRL compliant)
points.speed: From field to freezer in under 6 hours
